news.title: Steelers rookie Allar stars as McCarthy beats Packers on debut
news.summary: Rookie Drew Allar starred in Mike McCarthy's first game as Pittsburgh Steelers head coach, throwing two touchdown passes and running for another in a 28-9 preseason win over the Green Bay Packers.
